occurrenceRemarks: Tampa Christmas Bird Count with Charlie Fisher, Erik Haney, and John Mangold. Sites visited include Mary Help of Christians Center, the Southwest Florida Water Management District's US-301 service center, Eureka Springs Park, Tampa Executive Airport, Temple Terrace Riverfront Preserve Park, several publicly-owned properties along the Tampa Bypass Canal, and several privately-owned stormwater retention ponds/wetlands, all in the east-central portion of the CBC circle. We started at 0625 and ended about 1750. The weather at the start was pre-sunrise and clear, 48 degrees ("feels like" 45) with winds from the N at 7 MPH. It remained clear and mildly windy all day, and the temperature warmed up to 65 degrees before dropping again. We did well, especially with small, flocking passerines. John found what was by far our best bird: a juvenile Magnolia Warbler at Riverside Preserve Park (my images are rather dreadful, but Erik at least got definitive images). These are my cell-phone images (162 in all), automatically geo-referenced and time-stamped. They are almost exclusively plants. My camera photographs will follow later today.
